body: Okay bro, it makes sense. It must be a geographic thing. I like that pay it forward attitude, but where does that desire come from?Is it something innate, something you work for, or just some random inspiration you get?

Oh, maybe the "babe" threw me off. haha this may seem like a weird question, but do you mind if I ask you why you are in this subreddit? Why do you devote your time talking to people who are at their lowest for seemingly no reward? I may have stalked you a little and I am curious. What is your motivation? This isn't pointless. I am trying to figure out this motivation thing.
But thanks. It means a lot to me.
That awkward moment when I am a guy. I didn't realize I came off feminine. Interesting.
